docstring:
Returns the bounding box of the object that is spatially to the right of the object in the given bounding box.

Args:
    image (image): Image of the scene.
    bbox (list): A bounding box [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] containing the reference object.

Returns:
    list: A bounding box [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] of the object to the right, or None if no such object exists.

Returns the real-world length of an object in meters, given its bounding box and a known reference length for that object.

Args:
    image (image): Image of the scene.
    bbox (list): A bounding box [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] containing the object.
    known_length (float): The known real-world length of the object in meters.

Returns:
    float: The real-world length of the object in meters.
